title: Agile buttons: the Assistant gets Sprint report and Status update buttons; sessions get Status update and Are you done?

requirements.text: An Assistant pane has a Sprint report button whose prompt makes it report the sprint that just ended (when the current one is under two days old) plus the ongoing sprint, and lets it look back at any sprint
requirements.check: eye: TJ presses Sprint report on the Assistant in the relaunched app and gets the last sprint plus this one

requirements.text: An Assistant pane has a Status update button
requirements.check: eye: TJ sees and presses it on the Assistant

requirements.text: Each session pane has Status update and Are you done? buttons
requirements.check: eye: TJ sees both on a session pane

requirements.text: The sprint-report prompt is built from genlock sprint output, not typed facts
requirements.check: file: the prompt text names genlock sprint commands

evidence: app/Sources/GenlockCore/Voice.swift SessionLaunch.sprintReport(all:): prompt names genlock sprint --json, genlock sprint previous, -N, YYYY-MM-DD, --from/--to; says report only what the command shows. swift build complete

text: Built: Assistant panes (hub + project) get Sprint report button (SessionLaunch.sprintReport, 48h just-ended rule); session panes get Status update next to Are you done?. swift build ok. Remaining: TJ eyes them after relaunch.
